reviews.title: Totally smooth
reviews.text: All airlines have about a 2 star rating these days (mainly due to passengers getting a raw deal during covid) so I wasn’t too concerned with any negative reviews- as ppl don’t tend to leave a review if everything went fine. Food was good, staff were friendly and we were given an iPad to watch a section of films on)- Tip, bring your own headphones to plug in (not with iPhone adapter). Thanks TAAG, another flight with a happy customer
reviews.author: Dom

reviews.title: Poor airline service  fr Johannesburg to Lisbon
reviews.text: Transit halls at airport capital city of Angola very poor service ancient shouting for calling passengers Lack faceleties visa card dnt work on any coffee food payment No entertainment in all fligths no phone charger I will not use again Need much improvement if wish passengers
reviews.author: sodagarabdull

reviews.title: Not happy to have my ticket cancelled and then asked for double the amount to be able to take same flight
reviews.text: I bout a ticket with TAAG on the 8/5/2023, got eticket. A weeklater my ticket is not valid and money sent back into account with no further explanation. When I called their help desk said they no longer had tickets at that value and If I wanted to take same flight had to pay 1200 euros. Sorry TAAG, you are not professional!
reviews.author: Olivia P

reviews.title: All went smoothly and flights were fine
reviews.text: After reading all the bad reviews, I was wary about flying with Taag but it was the quickest route by far to Cape Town and the price was also reasonable. Everything was fine. We are a family with a child and had no problems. There were no delays on any flights, we took 6 in total between us all, staff were friendly and helpful , not over friendly but fine. No entertainment but that was fine as knew that. Food wasn't bad at all. Overall I wanted to share this as I was really worried after reading the reviews but it all worked out well and glad we flew with them to save us time. I know a few people who have used them for the same route and also no complaints.
reviews.author: Karin G

reviews.title: Thieves and scammers!!!
reviews.text: As per the many disgruntled passengers on this TAAG blog, I too have been fleeced to the tune of $3500 for tickets I purchased in FEB2020, which were cancelled due to COVID. Despite a plethora of Email exchanges with their incompetent customer service agents I have to date had no refund or even an option of a voucher for future travel. This is contrary to their continued reassurance that the matter will be resolved in due course. (been 3 years now) I don't know what further I can do or what other options I have to take this further. One of the complainants with the same problem mentioned that they are considering taking his case up with an airline Lawyer. Could you please let the rest of us know haw your case is going and if there is any hope for us to get our money back.,,,,, ever?
reviews.author: Tim f

reviews.title: Is this a joke or
reviews.text: My sister who left São Paulo on Monday is arriving in joberg only on Thursday after being routed all through various countries in Europe bc of this poor excuse for a airline. I, myself, am now currently stuck in the Luanda airport with no word on when we are getting out of here and all of the boarding passes for our flight home have been aggressively confiscated by the rude airline staff. I have flown over seas hundreds of times and have never experienced anything more disorganized. The state of the planes are there is no entertainment even if they have screens. The smaller planes have literal sharp metal sticking into your back and the chairs don’t even recline. My partner and I are laughing at this point bc it feels like we are no longer living in reality with all this going on. Why were our boarding passes taken away from us. Why will no one tell us what is happening? This is too much man. Do yourself the biggest favor and avoid avoid avoid. Don’t make the same mistake we did. We hope we make it out of here in one piece.
reviews.author: Blake S

reviews.title: TAAG: Paying for Nothing - A Costly and Disappointing Flying Experience
reviews.text: I recently had the "pleasure" of flying with TAAG, the Angolan airline that makes you wonder if time actually exists. Seriously, their flights are so delayed that you could have time to write a novel or learn a new language while waiting for your plane to finally take off. And don't even get me started on their customer service. When my return flight was delayed by more than 7 hours, I knew I would miss my connecting flight in Luanda. But did TAAG care? Not one bit. They wouldn't refund my ticket even though I didn't even take the flight to Luanda because I knew I would be stranded there without a visa to enter the country. But hey, at least their ticket prices are high enough to make you think you're flying with a premium airline, right? Wrong. In fact, after flying with TAAG even Ryanair would feel like a premium airline. In all seriousness, if you're looking for an airline that doesn't value your time or money, then go ahead and fly with TAAG. Otherwise, save yourself the hassle and choose a different airline for your next trip.
reviews.author: Christian H

reviews.title: Nightmare flight
reviews.text: I was initially impressed by the punctuality of the flight from Johannesburg to Luanda. However the condition of the aircraft was shocking. All the in-flight entertainment on our in-seat screens (6 x seats) were defective! We were also unable to use the bulkhead lights as the controls for these are integrated in the defective in-flight entertainment controls. I reported the defective equipment to a flight attendant as we were unable to follow the safety briefing (which was only shown on the in-seat screens). The flight attendant was non-fussed about the equipment and ignored this fact, leaving us to enjoy a long and uncomfortable flight with no in-flight entertainment. I wrote to the airline on our return but they have not even bothered to recognise receipt. Stay clear, there are many other better airline options!
reviews.author: André W

reviews.title: Smooth and pleasant experience
reviews.text: My family flew from Joburg to Sao Paolo via Luanda during Dec '22/Jan '23. Was nervous to fly after reading all the bad reviews, but really it was great. Going this route was shorter and a lot cheaper than the available alternatives. All the flights departed on time and arrived on time. Check in, etc. was smooth. We used their Whatsapp enquiry service at some point and got a fairly prompt response. Food was fine (though no veg option), service was fine, Luanda airport was fine (great coffee!). There is no entertainment on the flight (bring a book!), but we had absolutely no problems in any of the flights (six flights in total between different family members).
reviews.author: Sally M

reviews.title: Couldn’t organise a p*** up in a brewery
reviews.text: To paint the picture for those who don't read the whole review: A group of 4 of us were flying from Cape Town to Luanda, and then onto Brussels on TAAG. A simple trip in my mind; two flights and we're at our destination. Somehow TAAG were able to turn it into 24 hours in a hotel in Luanda, 4 flights, 1 lost bag, and about 56 hours of travel. The full story: We arrived at Cape Town International Airport a good few hours before our flight was meant to leave. Upon check in, we were told our flight is delayed as the plane hadn't even left Angola yet (4 hour flying time to CT). Bear in mind, we had to catch a connecting flight from Luanda to Brussels later that night. Based on the delay, we had an inclining that we would not make the connecting flight, but our hands were tied at that point - we'd have to figure it out once we got to Luanda. The flight itself to Luanda wasn't bad, to be honest. The food wasn't Michelin star, but it was okay for a 4 hour flight. Something to note is that there was no entertainment system onboard. Once we arrived in Luanda, we went to the "Connecting Flights" area where someone was checking passports and boarding passes. We had already missed our connecting flight so the representative asked for our passports so he could try get us on a flight that night going via Lisbon, Portugal. We ended up waiting in this area for over an hour with little to no communication about what was happening and when we'll get our passports back. Eventually we were led up
reviews.author: Bryn L

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: I booked a trip to Portugal at short notice. Was a little nervous to use TAAG because of some of the terrible reviews, but I was pleasantly surprised. Although some of the aircraft are old and worn, the service was great and all my flights on time. Food is pretty much what you can expect on any economy flight. I found the attendants at check in and on the plane to be polite and well trained. I took my tablet with me so didn't need to use the on board entertainment systems. Add too this the over generous luggage allowance (2 checked in bags of 23kg) per person you are getting your money's worth
reviews.author: Ash

reviews.title: Worst Airlines Ever
reviews.text: We flew from Cape Town to Angola, most of the charging ports was broken. Seats was dirty, food was terrible and the staff was just as bad. Nobody even attempted to try or help to speak English. The staff didn't even smile, myself snd wife counted how many staff we spoke to or tried and not even a friendly face. When we arrived to Angola and flight to Midrid was even the same. I am born in Africa and was ashamed on how they treated us and others. It was very sad to see this happen and be treated like this. I have 3 kids and they told me please fir us never to fly with them again. When to got to Gatwick, all our luggage was missing. Such a shame really.
reviews.author: Delton P

reviews.title: TAAG has to be the most unprofessional airline of all times!!!!!
reviews.text: Taag must be the most unprofessional airline ever!!!!!! After four months of sending TAAG a claim for our first needs, due to them having lost our luggage for the whole duration of our holiday, in July, they totally ignore their Harare office's emails as well as mine. This behaviour is not only unacceptable but totally unprofessional. This is how they treat their business class passengers and it is their attitude with everything. No wonder their crew share the same behaviour. Taag should be ashamed of themselves to say the very least!!!!!!
reviews.author: paula conceicao

reviews.title: Terrible booking management service, horrible airport, bad airconditioned fligt
reviews.text: This is the worst airline i have ever flown. I had to change my flights to a week later and after contacting the airline by phone, Whatsapp, Messenger, Instagram and Email, nobody helped me for 4 days. When someone eventually decided to assist me then they kep on requesting information that i had sent them more than 5 times within the same chat/conversation. Then continued to tell me this was my error when after i made the payment to change my flight through TAAGs online platform, an error page popped up and i heard nothing else in return. The airline took my money and I heard nothing back from them. In addition, the aircraft was incredibly stuffy and hot and the airconditioning did not work. The airport charged us 23 Euros for 4 bottles of water, there was no wifi and no staff to help the passengers find boarding gates, bathrooms or a place to buy refreshments. The bathrooms in the airport were infested with cockroaches too, on top of them not being clean of course. Will never be flying this airline again after my return flight. Absolute dissapointment and definitely not worth the little money you save compared to other airlines.
reviews.author: Joselle R

reviews.title: 2 flights, they left my bag on both of them!
reviews.text: They have never been great, but they are at a new low! They left my bag behind on outbound and again on my return flight. In Luanda they don't answer your calls and you have to go back to the airport to get your bag the following day. Now in jhb and trying to phone to see if my bag has been sent on this flight..the Menzies number they gave me assuring me it woukd work - 0119207511 hasn't been answered after numerous calls all day.. The number for the taag jhb airport office on their website :(+27) 11 450-1116, when you phone it... You get a voice message saying the number doesn't exist! Do yourself a favour, never fly this airline
reviews.author: Andy J

reviews.title: Taag  ignores their passenger claims, and they will not respond .
reviews.text: My husband and I travelled from JNB to LIS on the 29th July and TAAG lost our luggage and it was only found the day we travelled back home on the 15th Aug. On our return I put a claim through for 1st needs which were mainly medication. We live in Harare and all the emails I send to TAAG in JNB do not get acknowledged. I WhatsApp TAAG and their response was for me to go personally to their JNB offices to resolve my issue....With todays technology they expect me to buy another ticket just to go and see them personally!!!This airline is unprofessional to say the least and do anything to avoid paying. I will not desist, as it is a matter of principle now! If there was an option I would give them minus 5 stars. Their attitude is as bad as the crew on board. They act like they are doing us passengers a favour to fly with them. Their aircrafts from and to JNB are disgusting. The seats are torn, the aircraft is smelly,the arm rests are glued. Its got to be seem for anyone to believe it!
reviews.author: paula conceicao

reviews.title: Refund
reviews.text: STILL waiting for my 2019 Covid refund...I keep sending emails, sometimes I receive a reply requesting copies of ticket, mostly just... nothing! (did not travel, but this review forced a travel date entry)
reviews.author: 464tony

reviews.title: This airline is a scam.
reviews.text: I booked a flight in August, to fly in November 12th. At the beginning of October, this airline had a pilot strike and there was no certainty that they would be able to service the flight at all, so I called the airline to cancel the ticket -- what followed was OVER A MONTH of calls, emails, and Whatsapp messages. They initially said over the phone, in October, that the ticket would be refunded due to the strike, but they had no details. With that knowledge, I booked a ticket on a different airline and started calling them regularly for more information. After a couple of weeks, they gave me an email address to submit the request to, but the email address errored out. After calling their phone numbers in two different countries, I got another two email addreses to contact, none of which ever replied. Finally on November 3rd, only nine days before the flight, the callcenter told me that they would cancel the ticket, but because the strike was already over I wasn't entitled to a refund of any kind, and moreover, I would be fined $200 on my next ticket for canceling the flight. They also refused to provide any written confirmation of the cancellation or the exchanges. I am debating issuing a credit card chargeback and explaining the situation to them.
reviews.author: Leandro M

reviews.title: LOST TICKETS
reviews.text: Four tickets purchased January 2020, covid changed our lives. Our beautiful skies closed for 2020 and 2021. TAAG cannot find the four tickets in their system. I have knocked on all possible doors and ALL have been closed. Our then agent - Carrolo Travel have done nothing in assisting to recover these tickets, but SADLY carries on issuing tickets, TAAG representative in South Africa - Rogers Aviation Senior Management advised me to wait and pray. TAAG Head Office in Luanda have ignored my request for some feedback. This battle has been ongoing for over three years. Where to from here, media and courts, but all we want is what is rightfully ours. Victims So of course they carry on flying and promoting/sponsoring tickets on air, our STOLEN tickets to the same community they are stealing from.
reviews.author: Rose

reviews.title: Seriously the worst of the worst I've ever seen
reviews.text: Both flights were 3 hours delayed without communication. First flight delay was because of a fuel stop which apparently happens regularly. The return flights were then even cancelled and there was no alternative route offered via other airlines so that I was stranded 4 days (at the moment 4 days at least) in a shabby hotel in Lisbon. I have checked with real estate agents and am aware of alternative routes with other airlines which taag isn't willing to consider. Communication is horrible also. Aircrafts are also poor. Just to give a quick example: there is no TV on any of the flights i've been on - not even in business class. Not that this matters that much but it explains the quality in general. Overall experience 0/10 and I will never fly with them again. Such a sh!t show this airline. Horrible horrible horrible.
reviews.author: Johannes H

reviews.title: Always enjoy TAAG
reviews.text: I’ve always had pleasant experiences with TAAG. Friendly service and I’ve always thought the food is good. The entertainment system currently being down is a bit of an inconvenience, but as I usually fly overnight then I’m not that bothered as I want to sleep. I’m excited about the new changes and new destinations I’ve heard about which will make connectivity around Africa and beyond much better. Just what we need
reviews.author: Dom

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: Flight cancelled after time to board. The person handling this whole debacle (Elizabeth of TAAG) lost control of the situation before it even started. I was abandoned in no man’s land (by immigration) for two hours with no one coming to my assistance. Luggage lost and absolutely no customer service of any value at all. It is no more than two weeks and I appalled at TAAG. Do not travel TAAG - it is definitely not worth the cheaper price. AVOID at all costs.
reviews.author: Fiona D

reviews.title: Amazing service by the operator in Cape Town since 2 luggages we’re missing!
reviews.text: I was very surprised by the service up on arrival since two of our luggages stayed behind in São Paulo, the operator in Cape Town called Damian was extremely helpful and took his job very seriously. He updated us constantly and allocated our bags. Two days later our bags arrived as promised in perfect condition. I must say I was very impressed with the overall service, since I travel a lot I’m used with the grid. But Damian went over and above to make sure we were informed about our bags . Flight was ok just the food not great but ok .
reviews.author: Juliana Vermeiren

reviews.title: The worst experience in my whole life...Never use this airline -
reviews.text: Never use TAAG they have a horible and disgusting service Essentially what happened is that I left Lisbon for Luanda without any problems, but from then on it was a nightmare. When we arrived in Luanda our flight should have left at 10am but the company, without justifying anything to the passengers delayed the flight and we only left at 11am. The justification that was given to the people who sicked for information was that the crew was late. When the crew arrived, everything was done in a hurry and we boarded to Johannesburg. The pilot told us that the problem was slight, but the flight attendant said that it was serious and that we should urgently land in Unjiva. When you were about to try to land, the pilot was told that he could not get off and we do not know why (some say that TAAG owes money to Unjiva airport). We were then forced to return to Angola and land at Lubango Airport, in a province which is a long way from the capital and has no international airport. We got there around 2pm, after many turns in the air with the plane breaking down, which forced a forced landing. There was no food or water. at 4pm, due to the lack of information, we asked for clarification as to what our destination would be from then on and there was no answer. to eat, they went to get a cheese sandwich with juice that was inside the plane and some bottles of water to distribute among the people. We insisted in wanting to know what would become of us, we were told that a TAAG technician was
reviews.author: Jeremias Chemane

reviews.title: Shocking service!
reviews.text: We flew with Taag yesterday 2/4/22. Firstly they were 4 hours delayed. We were given a roll with 2 slices of chicken in a tiny salad for dinner. One glass of red wine and nothing else. No one offered tea coffe, water or another drink. I went to the galley to ask for another glass of red wine and was told they have none. On a half full plane!!! No soap in the toilets to was your hands either. We saw the crew once during the flight and not again. The TV or movies did not work either! Shocking or rather no service! Wake up TAAG!
reviews.author: Allison P

reviews.title: TAAG Nightmare
reviews.text: DO NOT USE this airline. It’s one thing being held up at check-in for more than 2 hours, but it’s unconscionable not to have toilet paper and soap on the flight, especially in COVID times.
reviews.author: Jan Henning Van Schalkwyk

reviews.title: Dr Jonathan
reviews.text: Never ever make the mistake to buy Angolan Air line Taag ticket. the personnel are very bad don't listen to Customers,,it a nightmare, from Airport staff to the Air hostels, the ground staff at the airport will make pay them or threatens you not to Board the plane, immigration giving false information asking a British citizen visa to transit Lisbon. Refused me to board asked the to put my ticket on hold they all refused at Taag counter international Airport. Called police at airport was told they can't do anything must go at the head office for Refused went was told they can only refund me after one year. Proof of the all scenario video and pictures provided on the request.
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.title: THEY DO NOT REFUND !!!!! Thieves! Ladroes!!!!!
reviews.text: On Feb 2020 I got a biz class tkt from S Africa to Brazil for Dec 2020. I was going to be returning from a Cruise to S Africa. Mid March, the world changed with Covid, all trips cancelled, all cruises cancelled, I contact Taag to cancel my reservation and request a refund, based on the fare I purchased, which was NOT non refundable. Reservation was cancelled in Oct. I was offered to use the credit in an other flight till the end of 2021. I said I was not interested and wanted to be refunded. They said it would take a while. Now in Mar 2021, I called their office in Sao Paulo and was told to send a refund request to an email address. I did. Realized later it was the same email address I had done it back in Aug. So how can anyone rate an airline like Taag. Next time I have to write about it, it will be to an airline laywer.
reviews.author: Walter R

reviews.title: Still no refund or information about cancelled flight
reviews.text: We were supposed to fly to Namibia last Saturday but did not receive any flightn cancellation information and/or refund information. Also the website nor the hotline is very helpful and we do not think that we can rebook the flight or get our money back. We can not recommend this airline!
reviews.author: Aaron

reviews.title: TAAG is mute, they don’t care about the customers
reviews.text: My flight between Cabo Verde and São Tomé was cancelled. TAAG doesn’t give you information about that. They don’t even give information about COVID situation on their website. They don’t even refund, they tell you that due to the lockdown it is not possible. Although they are working, although some of their plane are still flying. They lie and don’t care about you.
reviews.author: Manu
